VolumeSpaceChange.description: Observed volume free-space change, separate from per-item processed-size estimates. Concurrent filesystem activity can contribute to this change.

error.description: Why measurement was unavailable; this does not change the deletion outcome.

freeBytesAfter.description: Free bytes on the same filesystem after the batch command has exited.

freeBytesBefore.description: Free filesystem bytes immediately before the batch, including reserved free blocks.

scope.description: Human-readable operation scope, such as a snapshot configuration name.

description: Display totals that keep shared-storage operations out of unknown byte counts.

reclaimed_bytes.description: Known processed bytes for byte-accounted handlers, not measured freed disk space.

snapshot_already_absent_group_count.description: Completed snapshot selections already absent before this execution; they freed zero bytes.

snapshot_group_count.description: Successfully processed snapshot selection units; a pre/post pair is one group.

snapshot_space_changes.description: Distinct snapshot deletion batches, each measured once on its own volume.

unknown_size_item_count.description: Byte-accounted selections whose complete processed-size estimate is unknown.

title: CleanupSizeSummary
